semiconductor_relevance: Medium — KINGVAST provides critical facility monitoring and fire protection systems for high-tech industries, including semiconductors.
summary: KINGVAST Technology specializes in providing facility monitoring and control systems, as well as fire protection solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their services enhance operational safety and productivity by mitigating production risks and protecting critical assets.
capabilities: Fire protection systems for wet process equipment

regional_presence.Taiwan: KINGVAST is the authorized agent for fire protection systems from Japan's HATSUTA SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD. in Taiwan.
